identificationModule.briefTitle: Targeted BEACOPP Variants in Patients With Newly Diagnosed Advanced Classical Hodgkin Lymphoma

descriptionModule.briefSummary:
The Purpose of this trial is:

* to determine complete response rate (CRR) after six cycles of chemotherapy
* to determine complete remission rate (CR/CRr) as final treatment outcome after completion of treatment

armGroups.label: BrECAPP
armGroups.description: modified BEACOPP by omitting Bleomycin and adding Brentuximab Vedotin

armGroups.label: BrECADD
armGroups.description: modified BEACOPP by omitting Bleomycin, Procarbazine and Prednisone and adding Brentuximab Vedotin, Dacarbazine and Dexamethasone

primaryOutcomes.measure: Response rate (RR) after six cycles of chemotherapy
Complete remission rate (CR/CRr) as final treatment outcome after completion of treatment

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Histologically proven classical Hodgkin lymphoma
* First diagnosis, no previous treatment, age: 18-60 years
* Stage IIB with large mediastinal mass and/or extranodal lesions, stage III or IV disease

Exclusion Criteria:

* Composite lymphoma or nodular lymphocyte- predominant Hodgkin lymphoma (NLPHL)
* Previous malignancy
* Prior chemotherapy or radiation

locations.facility: 1st Dept. of Medicine, Cologne University Hospital
